question: Which band, Letters to Cleo or Screaming Trees, had more members?

citations.claim: Letters to Cleo has members Kay Hanley, Greg McKenna, Michael Eisenstein, Stacy Jones, Scott Riebling, and later Tom Polce — total of 6 members.

Screaming Trees had four founding members (Mark Lanegan, Gary Lee Conner, Van Conner, Mark Pickerel) and later replaced Pickerel with Barrett Martin, so the core lineup consisted of 4 members at a time.
